verdict.rationale: The docs describe Bugbot as analyzing PR diffs (docs-24) and drawing context from existing PR comments (docs-5). Project conventions only reach it through user-authored `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` guidelines, automatically learned rules and org-wide rules (docs-6, docs-34, docs-29). Nothing in the evidence shows it reading call sites or related modules outside the changed hunks. Missing for 10: evidence of repository-wide indexing or context retrieval, analysis of call sites and dependent modules, automatic inference of existing codebase conventions, and independent corroboration of cross-file findings.
